mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase equity risk premiums, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or Rank IC over 2-year window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer spending that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) triggers expected monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0, or Rank IC over 2-year window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payrolls growth signals sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 2-year window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in GDP and housing starts signals broad economic strength that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate investment.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes with high housing starts and strong retail sales, sustained consumer spending drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods with high HOUST and RSAFS, or Rank IC for regime is below 0.03.
